metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for implementing a deprecated @session decorator wrapper that delegates to @trace. It has unique semantic identity (decorator backward compatibility routing), different task_family (api_migration vs. peer candidates' observability_instrumentation, compatibility_maintenance, initialization), and does not overlap with existing skills which focus on trace filtering, data preparation, and thread pool execution. Peer candidates address related but separate concerns (span hierarchy, global state sync, legacy module sync) and do not subsume this decorator wrapper pattern.
